capacities.description: Controlled train movement within authorized limits.
Track and rolling-stock guidance sufficient for continued movement.
Containment of loaded cars during abnormal mechanical exposure.
Emergency isolation, evacuation, and response after loss of containment.

facts: A freight train left the track on a two-main-track segment.
Some loaded cars lost containment and a fire followed.
The segment had a stated speed limit and a train-control system.
The investigation remained ongoing; no final cause is included.
